howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps from pothole to fixed.

step1.label: Step 1
step1.title: Snap a photo
step1.description: Capture the road damage with your phone. Location is tagged automatically.

step2.label: Step 2
step2.title: AI detects the issue
step2.description: Our model identifies the damage type and severity in seconds.

step3.label: Step 3
step3.title: Routed to authorities
step3.description: The report reaches the right local authority and you get email updates.

aiIntelligence.title: AI-Powered Safety Intelligence
aiIntelligence.subtitle: Advanced computer vision, risk analysis, and predictive insights help communities identify hazards faster, prioritize responses, and prevent accidents before they happen.

detection.title: Smart Hazard Detection
detection.description: AI automatically identifies potholes, flooding, road debris, fallen trees, damaged infrastructure, and traffic hazards from images and reports in real time.
detection.imageAlt: AI computer vision detecting a pothole and flooding on a road

severity.title: Severity Assessment
severity.description: Every detected hazard receives an AI-generated risk score to help authorities prioritize critical incidents and allocate resources efficiently.

predictive.title: Predictive Analytics
predictive.description: Analyze historical reports, environmental conditions, and community activity to predict accident hotspots and emerging risk zones.

features.title: Built to get roads fixed
features.subtitle: Everything you need to report, track and resolve road damage.

detection.title: AI damage detection
detection.description: Detects potholes, cracks, waterlogging and debris automatically.

tracking.title: Real-time status tracking
tracking.description: Follow every report from submitted to resolved.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.description: Stay informed at every step with timely email updates.

offline.title: Offline report drafting
offline.description: Draft reports without a connection and sync when you're back online.

multilingual.title: Multi-language support
multilingual.description: Report in your language across all BIMSTEC nations.

countries.title: Built for all BIMSTEC nations
countries.subtitle: Serving seven member nations, with more coming online.

testimonials.title: Trusted by communities
testimonials.subtitle: Citizens and authorities across BIMSTEC nations rely on Reckoning every day.

t1.quote: I reported a dangerous pothole on my commute route. Within 3 days, the municipality had it repaired. This platform actually works.
t1.name: Priya Sharma

t2.quote: As a district officer, the AI severity scoring helps us prioritize the most dangerous road conditions first. Our response time improved by 60%.

t3.quote: The real-time tracking keeps me informed. I can see when my report is acknowledged and when repair work begins. Complete transparency.
t3.name: Suman Thapa
